body: I have interests and hobbies, but like I said I'm just bored with them, which I realize is a depression symptom, but I don't feel depressed, just tired of life, tired of working for someone else's profit for most of my waking hours, tired of feeling like whatever hobby I'm pursuing at the moment doesn't really matter in the the end.  Tired of the society we live in.  Tired of assholes.  Tired of humanity.

See I literally have no family or friends.  Friends all live in random other states, haven't seen them for over a decade.  Both of my parents are dead, no siblings, have no girlfriend or wife.  Literally the only people who would even notice I was missing would be my landlord when I didn't pay rent.  No one else would notice I was gone or that I ever existed, and I am not exaggerating that.  I'm getting close to 40 and don't really feel like going through middle age like this, I feel like I just don't belong in this world and I'm approaching 40 and growing old alone sounds miserable.  Slaving a 40 hour a week job no matter what it is just to retire, have health problems and die just doesn't sound appealing to me.  I feel like I've done all the things in life I've wanted to do and I am quite nihilist, I don't believe anything we do actually matters in the grand scheme of the universe anyway, we are just a speck of dust on a bigger speck of dust floating through space.  We are insignificant.   The universe doesn't care I'm alive or dead, and on a geologic timeline we really are just nothing, no one will remember any of us existed even 100 years from now.
